ABSOLUTELY KEEP image1's head/face/brown hair, torso and hip positions, entire lower body, thighs, knees, shins, ankles and both boot poses/positions/axes UNCHANGED. LEFT rear leg remains planted on its forefoot with heel raised; RIGHT free leg remains airborne and bent exactly as image1. Same scale, position, NE camera and full-square registration. Only sleeves/arms/held objects may change. No mirror, rescale, recentering, crop, text, background, shadow, extra anatomy or weapons. True transparent alpha.
